close-label.description: Localized accessible name of the trigger when it becomes the close control.

icon-name.description: Registered Lucide glyph for the closed trigger. The plus glyph ships with the component.

label.description: Accessible name of the closed trigger and of the menu.

open.description: Whether the action stack is open. Reflected when the user opens or dismisses it.

position.description: Static anchors to the host. Fixed anchors to the viewport's block-end inline-end corner.

scrim.description: Dim the viewport and dismiss on a scrim click. Use the boolean property or scrim="false" to opt out.

variant.description: Closed FAB surface. The open trigger always uses primary.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-fab-backdrop-filter.description: Complete optional filter behind the FAB.

--ki-fab-bg-image.description: Optional layer painted over the FAB fill.

--ki-fab-fg.description: Ink on the tinted secondary FAB.

--ki-fab-forced-colors-border-width.description: Boundary width for the FAB in forced colors.

--ki-fab-hover-shadow.description: FAB elevation for a pointer that can hover.

--ki-fab-icon-size.description: Glyph size of the default FAB.

--ki-fab-menu-scrim-backdrop-filter.description: Complete optional filter behind the scrim.

--ki-fab-menu-scrim-bg.description: Dimming fill behind the open menu and its trigger.

--ki-fab-menu-scrim-bg-image.description: Optional image painted above the scrim fill.

--ki-fab-menu-trigger-bg.description: Fill of the closed trigger in the default secondary variant: the secondary FAB's tonal fill, or in onmars v2 the primary FAB ink, so the accent stays on selection, links and focus.

--ki-fab-menu-trigger-fg.description: Glyph ink on the closed secondary trigger.

--ki-fab-menu-trigger-gap.description: Gap between the last action and the FAB.

--ki-fab-mobile-nav-block-size.description: Height to reserve for mobile navigation, excluding the safe-area inset.

--ki-fab-offset.description: Fixed FAB gap to the viewport edge or mobile navigation.

--ki-fab-primary-fg.description: Ink on the strong primary FAB.

--ki-fab-radius.description: Corner radius of the default FAB size.

--ki-fab-size.description: Minimum FAB footprint in the default size.

--ki-fab-surface-fg.description: Ink on the raised surface FAB.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

component.description: An icon FAB that opens two to six related actions above its trigger.

ki-close.description: Emitted when the action stack closes.

ki-open.description: Emitted when the action stack opens.

ki-select.description: Emits the selected item's value or its trimmed label. Native links retain their destination.

menu.description: The named action list above the trigger.

scrim.description: The optional pointer-dismissible overlay behind the menu.

trigger.description: The native floating button that opens and closes the menu.

closeLabel.description: Localized accessible name of the trigger when it becomes the close control.

iconName.description: Registered Lucide glyph for the closed trigger. The plus glyph ships with the component.

label.description: Accessible name of the closed trigger and of the menu.

open.description: Whether the action stack is open. Reflected when the user opens or dismisses it.

position.description: Static anchors to the host. Fixed anchors to the viewport's block-end inline-end corner.

scrim.description: Dim the viewport and dismiss on a scrim click. Use the boolean property or scrim="false" to opt out.

variant.description: Closed FAB surface. The open trigger always uses primary.

slots.description: Two to six direct ki-fab-menu-item children, in top-to-bottom order.
